text:
Anya: Heads-up — small design review for the latency/throughput dashboard compact mode. Found a few UX nits when the panel is narrow:
- p95 label truncates (gets shown as "p9...")
- legend density becomes a wrap-mess and pushes the heatmap down
- sampling control feels visually disconnected from the timepicker (users keep missing it)
Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.screens/latency/compact-clip.png

Mike: On the truncation: the label is a fixed-width chip in CSS right now. We can switch to an append badge for p95 (e.g., "Latency · p95") which avoids truncation and keeps row height consistent. Grid can reflow legend to a single line at >= 720px, below that we collapse into an overflow menu.

Jordana: I worry about discoverability — p95 is the critical metric, should be visually prioritized over p50. Can we make the p95 badge slightly more prominent (weight + color) and keep toggles for p50/p95 on the same row as the metric name? Also callout: do we need "per-route" vs "per-model" toggle here? Might confuse product teams.

Sam: From metrics side: heatmap fidelity is directly impacted by the sampling rate. Defaulting to 10% for long-range views keeps costs down but we should surface a clear tooltip explaining tradeoffs. +1 on moving sampling into the top header area so it's in the same visual plane as time range.

Olga: A11y nits:
- Contrast: the current purple for p95 on dark backgrounds fails 4.5:1 in a couple of states. Please run the color through the contrast checker.
- Tooltips: must be accessible via keyboard focus and should have role=tooltip plus aria-describedby on the triggering element.
- Time-range chips need focus outlines and aria-pressed states for keyboard users.
- Avoid shorthand like "95p" in labels — screen readers read that weirdly. Use "p95 latency".

Ethan: Copy tweak suggestions for tooltip and sampling dropdown:
- Tooltip: "Sampling rate — percentage of requests used to build the heatmap; higher = more accurate but higher cost."
- Sampling dropdown options: "1% (fastest, coarse)", "5% (default for month range)", "10% (balanced)", "100% (full)"
ARIA snippet for the sampling control: ```<select aria-label="Sampling rate (affects heatmap precision)">...</select>```

Anya: Nice — quick action list: (1) Mike: try badge approach for p95 and collapsed legend overflow (2) Sam: default sampling suggestions and add tooltip copy (3) Olga: run contrast check + keyboard focus patterns (4) Ethan/Jordana: approve prominence tweaks and copy. If no blockers I can ship a small PR with the layout CSS + copy tweaks tomorrow.

Mike: Sounds good. I'll prototype the badge and send a short demo gif.

Jordana: +1 for the prominence + copy. Keep per-route toggle as an advanced option (collapsed).

Olga: Will run the accessibility checklist and post results here by EOD.

Ethan: I'll update the tooltip copy and add the aria snippet to the components doc.

Anya: Thanks all :thumbsup:
